home.welcome_subtitle: A bilingual, PWA-first foundation for fitness coaching.
home.placeholder_notice: These screens demonstrate the Phase 04 foundation only; product workflows are not implemented.

pwa.install_description: Add CoachOS to your Home Screen for quick access.
pwa.offline_notice: Offline — unsaved input is retained temporarily in memory; reconnect before saving.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: CoachOS cannot reach the network. Reconnect to continue with online features.
offline.cached_content_notice: Previously cached foundation pages may remain available. No durable offline data queue is enabled.

errors.not_found_description: The requested page does not exist in this foundation shell.
errors.server_error_description: The page could not be displayed. Please try again.

placeholders.athlete_today_desc: Foundation shell for the future athlete workout experience.
placeholders.coach_programs_desc: Foundation shell for the future coach program workspace.
placeholders.org_settings_desc: Foundation shell for future organization configuration.

training.title: Exercise library and program builder
training.description: Search the bilingual catalog, structure training weeks, and review prescriptions before saving.
training.saved_status: Program draft is ready to save to the active organization.
training.keyboard_hint: Use the move up and move down buttons as a keyboard alternative to drag and drop.
training.no_organization: No active organization is available for this account.
training.unauthorized: You are not authorized to use this coach or owner workspace.
training.context_error: Organization context could not be loaded.
training.catalog_error: Exercise catalog could not be loaded.
training.save_error: Program could not be saved. Review the fields and try again.
training.select_exercise: Select an exercise from the catalog.

athlete.today_subtitle: Your scheduled session from the coach's program.
athlete.today_empty_desc: There is no active assignment scheduled for today. Check back later.
athlete.today_forbidden_desc: You do not have access to this athlete workspace.
athlete.offline_notice: Offline — unsaved input is kept in memory only; reconnect to save.
athlete.reason_required_error: A reason is required to substitute.
athlete.feedback_subtitle: Subjective feedback for your coach — this is not a medical diagnosis.
athlete.feedback_non_clinical: This report is for your coach's awareness only and is not medical advice.
athlete.progress_subtitle: Body metrics and progress photos — privacy controlled.
athlete.progress_photos_private: Photos are private. Only you, and coaches you consent to, can view them.
athlete.progress_consent_desc: Control who can view your progress photos and body metrics.
athlete.progress_consent_not_granted: Not shared with your assigned coach.
athlete.offline_desc: CoachOS cannot reach the network. Unsaved input is kept in memory.
athlete.unit_conversion: Load is recorded in kg on the server.

messaging.inbox_subtitle: Your one-to-one conversations with coaches and athletes.
messaging.inbox_empty_desc: When you and your coach start a conversation, it will appear here.
messaging.inbox_error_desc: The conversation list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
messaging.forbidden_desc: You do not have access to this conversation.
messaging.not_found_desc: This conversation does not exist or is no longer available to you.
messaging.conversation_empty_desc: Send the first message to start this conversation.
messaging.send_failed_desc: The message could not be sent. It is kept in the box so you can retry.
messaging.too_long: This message is too long. Shorten it and try again.
messaging.rate_limited: You are sending messages too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
messaging.archived: This conversation is archived and is read-only.
messaging.participant_inactive: The other participant is not currently active, so new messages cannot be sent.
messaging.unassigned: You are no longer assigned to this athlete, so you can read but not send.
messaging.offline_desc: Messages cannot be sent while offline. Nothing is queued for later; reconnect and send again.
messaging.muted_notice: Notifications for this conversation are muted.

notifications.empty_desc: There are no notifications to show right now.
notifications.refresh_hint: Notifications update when you refresh this page.

feedback_flag.title: Athlete reported discomfort
feedback_flag.body: {name} reported {severity} {flag_type} during a session. This is a self-reported note, not a medical assessment.

notification_prefs.title: Notification preferences
notification_prefs.subtitle: Choose which coaching events notify you and how.
notification_prefs.save_failed: Preferences could not be saved. Try again.
notification_prefs.channel_unavailable_desc: Email and browser push are not connected to a provider in this release. These settings are stored but nothing is delivered yet.
notification_prefs.locked_hint: Safety alerts always appear in the app and cannot be turned off.
notification_prefs.quiet_hours_desc: During quiet hours, email and browser push are held back until the window ends. In-app notifications are never delayed.
notification_prefs.timezone_note: Quiet hours use your profile timezone: {timezone}.
notification_prefs.push_denied_hint: Your browser is blocking notifications. In-app notifications still work.
